name: How to Repurpose Long-Form Videos into Shorts with IncuBrix
description: Step-by-step workflow to convert podcasts, webinars, and YouTube videos into viral short-form clips.

step.name: Upload Recording or Paste URL
step.text: Paste your YouTube, podcast, or Zoom recording URL into the IncuBrix studio.

step.name: AI Highlight Extraction & Auto-Reframing
step.text: IncuBrix extracts the highest-retention clips and crops active speakers to 9:16 vertical.

step.name: Export & Publish Across Socials
step.text: Customize animated captions and publish directly to TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
